rules.history: KEEP you and one ally repeat the FULL previous round. NEW caster plus one distinct actually willing,perceived allied creature within120ft/LoE at resolution; never select self twice. At ordinary commitment snapshot each actor's complete immutable log for the immediately preceding completed numbered round, not merely its last turn. Include all Action,Bonus Action,Reaction,voluntary movement segments,interactions,commands,extra-action/extra-turn events and the provenance of each, including failed/declined/zero-result committed attempts. Account for each entry as eligible,explicitly excluded or unavailable; do not silently trim the log. Source-defined forced movement,automatic damage,ticks,saves/death saves,environmental events and third-party acts are retained as context,not voluntary acts to regenerate. Outside initiative use the preceding complete fixed six-second world interval from an already established epoch; establish actual initiative before hostile replay. Missing or disputed complete history is a whole-case hold. Ready freezes the completed-round selection at paid preparation; later release never substitutes a newer round.
rules.phaseBudget: NEW explicit source-specific exception to the shared extra-full-Action cap: after the instantaneous outer resolves, run one finite caster phase then one finite ally phase in immutable historical order, before resuming ordinary queue progression. Each eligible historical Action/BA/Reaction entry supplies exactly one echo entitlement of that type; movement entry supplies no more than its historical paid movement cost,also capped by the current actual locomotion Speed for that entry. These entitlements are separate from normal current wallets,not a refill or another regular/extra turn. They can exceed the ordinary one-extra-full-Action slot ONLY for these fixed replay entries; no discretionary substitutions. Normal Action/BA/Reaction/movement/extra-slot records remain unchanged except the outer cast's actual Action or genuine independently chosen ordinary interrupts. No START/END,recharge,death save,rest,turn-only feature window or companion phase is created. Both phases must finish in this one serialized outer-resolution event,at the same elapsed timestamp before the enclosing regular slot resumes; micro-order is sequence only. No permission survives until a later turn.
rules.freshAttempts: Each entry uses the same actual acquired source,route,mode and fixed magnitudes/optional settings,with current body,stats,components,inventory and independent uses. It is a new attempt,with a new child eventID and fresh permitted RNG,not duplication of an old result. New targets/destinations may be selected through the original source's own range/consent/target-count rules. Movement starts from actual current position on a new legal path with no more historical cost; no teleport to old coordinates,refill of ordinary movement or illegal mode. Known unavailable predicates consume that entry without commitment/payment; hidden prevention after a legal commitment retains actual costs. Pay every current RP/material/charge,use and current Dissonance surcharge chronologically. No reservation of funds that do not exist,no negative balance,no restored items/HP/position,old payments or cooldown. Starting a child concentration really ends the old at commitment even if the child is countered.
rules.reactions: A historical Reaction entry is eligible only if its own REAL trigger is open at its ordered opportunity. No old trigger is assumed to happen again. If a fresh outsider response to the just-completed preceding replay entry opens that exact trigger, resolve this next pending historical Reaction node there before that triggering consequence. Otherwise consume it as no-current-trigger; do not wait,bank,reorder it past later history or invent an attack. A current ordinary Reaction may still be used independently through its real wallet; never charge both wallets for the same response. Outsiders use ordinary genuine Reaction/Ready windows and real resources; no extra enemy turn is supplied. Replayed attacks may provoke real consequences only within their own source rules.
rules.lineage: NEW finite no-recursion gate: exclude Time Echo,all copy/replay-descended payloads,and entries whose operative result grants further actions/turns/casting access,resource-loop or copy permissions. This includes actual Fate Echo,Echo Cast,Mirrorsage releases,feat copies and their generated payload descendants,never by a guessed name alone. Keep excluded nodes and reasons in the complete log. Explicit distinction: a separately chosen ordinary original action previously paid from a lawful Haste extra slot is not a copied payload; its own bounded action can repeat once, but repeating Haste's action-granting cast itself is excluded and no present Haste slot is refreshed. An ambiguous grant/copy ancestry without an exact adapter is a whole dependent branch hold. Intrinsic ordinary healing,summoning,protection or information is not forbidden merely because it could enable a later independent act; preserve actual shared limits and full source lifecycle. Auxiliary positive class/feat cast/on-hit/resource-refund/action-grant/copy hooks, whether automatic or optional, are suppressed on echo children under the existing no-duplicate-copy guard. Already-present passive defenses/bonuses and intrinsic spell results remain; this is no general removal of class passives. Mandatory negative restrictions,costs,strain,history,concentration and real intrinsic results remain. This does not reclassify original ordinary casts or change other wrappers.
rules.ownership: Each real recipient performs its own child through its retained acquired route and owns the result,with its own current PB/class stats. No borrowed repertoire or Time Echo-caster statistics. Original Wizard family history is preserved; repeating an already-used prepared family does not create a new first-family exemption. Preserve actual Mage/Cleric mandatory state changes without granting duplicate positive chain/refund/proc rewards. New damage roots use the child's actual dealer/current eligible Null,not historical donor flags or outer caster flags; pure descendants then keep that root. Existing summons/effects remain their original identities unless a genuine new cast lawfully replaces/creates one with actual caps and costs.
rules.commandsAndReady: An owner command entry retains the current source channel,command budget,actual companion identity and existing source-wide offense ledger; an Echo phase is not an attached companion phase,so no new offense/phase is invented. NEW bounded Ready adapter: a historical ordinary Ready setup can repeat only with a fully bound noncopy/non-action-granting payload. Its echo Action pays/prepares an actual new pending Ready,with real held concentration and next original own-START expiry. A historical release node can consume only that genuine newly prepared/current matching Ready on a new real trigger and its own eligible Echo Reaction; no second spell payment/cadence/counter at release. A release whose setup predates the selected round requires a current actually paid matching Ready; old historic payment does not satisfy it. This is the sole finite deferred-action adapter here,not general further-action access. Remaining actual Ready may persist to its ordinary deadline after Echo,using only a later normal Reaction; unspent Echo Reaction tokens never persist. Supplied proposed/unapplied Ready corrections are not adopted globally.
rules.interruptionPersistence: Countering the outer prevents both phases after keeping outer costs/history. Countering a child keeps earlier work and current child commitment,does not refund or restore prior concentration,and later independently legal entries may proceed. Revalidate each actor/entry at its actual checkpoint: death,removal or incapacity cancels that actor's remaining sequence; denied source/component/movement consumes only that entry unless its source imposes broader cancellation. Caster death after successful instantaneous grant does not itself cancel a still-living ally's independently granted sequence; it does cancel the caster's remaining entries and real caster-dependent child effects. Actual actor/source-qualified antimagic can block a child at its own checkpoint; the already completed instantaneous outer grant is not a persistent dispellable aura. Missing exact suppression/phase adapter stays held. Monotonic queue entries use (outerID,actorID,historicalEventID,ordinal),states pending/committed/resolved/skipped/cancelled and atomic current-state/resource/RNG/outcome receipts. A saved committed entry resumes at its uncompleted stage,never repeats payment/draw/outcome. A repeated processed ID is a no-op. On phase completion mark all entries terminal; no save/load replay,clock renewal or later banked opportunity.
